text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки performs incredibly well at
the NHK
Mile Cup.

The audience is utterly captivated by
her miracle.
The younger student's
depression and anger
begin to lift as
well.

Фудзи Кисэки wants to inspire people even
more. To
do so, she wants to enter the
Mile
Championship—the race where the
autumn queen
of the mile is decided and
where she'll also have
to face
senior-year racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, the next race on our schedule is
the Mile
Championship.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our race through the summer toward the
Mile
Championship and the strong
opponents waiting
there begins now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
